projects.title: XIV QR: Fashion Store UI
projects.alt: XIV QR fashion store e-commerce UI shown on a laptop and phone, designed by Great Emman-Wori
projects.brief: XIV QR is a menswear brand that needed an online store that feels as considered as its clothes. The brief was a clean, editorial shopping experience that works equally well on desktop and phone: a home page that sells the collection, a product listing with real filtering, a focused product page, and a cart and checkout with no friction. I designed the full flow in Figma with a restrained black and grey palette, a bold display typeface and generous photography.

story.title: An editorial home page
story.body: A bold condensed wordmark headline, a quiet grey paper texture and large model photography lead the home page, so the collection reads like a lookbook before it reads like a shop.

story.title: Filters that stay out of the way
story.body: The product listing pairs a collapsible filter column (size, availability, category, colour, price, tags, ratings) with a clean three-column grid. On mobile the same filters fold into an expandable panel above the products.

story.title: A short path to checkout
story.body: Product detail, cart and a three-step checkout (information, shipping, payment) share one layout language on desktop and phone, keeping the order summary visible while the customer fills in details.

results: A complete e-commerce flow designed for desktop and mobile: home, listing, product, cart and checkout
Consistent layout system across screen sizes, ready for developer handoff in Figma
Filtering and a three-step checkout that keep the path from browsing to buying short

projects.title: CON: E-Commerce Website UI
projects.alt: CON e-commerce website home page shown on a laptop, designed by Great Emman-Wori
projects.brief: CON is a multi-category online store. The brief was a clear, high-contrast shopping experience that gets customers from discovery to checkout quickly, covering the home page with category navigation and flash sales, product details, wishlist, cart, checkout, account, about, contact and error pages. I designed the full set of screens in Figma on a black, white and red palette.

story.title: A home page that sells straight away
story.body: A promo bar, a category sidebar and a full-width hero banner sit above a flash-sale strip with a live countdown, so shoppers see offers and navigation before they scroll.

story.title: From product to purchase in a few steps
story.body: The product page leads with large imagery, colour and size options and a single Buy Now action. Cart and checkout follow the same grid, keeping the order total in view while billing details are filled in.

story.title: Account, wishlist and support pages
story.body: Wishlist, account, about, contact and 404 screens reuse the same header, spacing and components, so the whole store feels like one system.

results: A complete e-commerce design in Figma covering 10 core screens, from home page to checkout
A consistent component and spacing system, ready for developer handoff
A short, clear path from browsing to buying, with account and wishlist built in

projects.title: WaContacts: WhatsApp Directory
projects.alt: WaContacts WhatsApp marketplace landing page shown on a laptop, designed by Great Emman-Wori
projects.brief: WaContacts is a WhatsApp-first marketplace and business directory for Nigeria. Buyers browse by category and chat with sellers directly on WhatsApp, while vendors post promotions, track performance and manage their plan. The brief was one clear, trustworthy product for both sides, covering the landing page, marketplace, sign up and sign in, vendor dashboard, promotion creation, profiles, in-app chat and pricing. I designed every screen in Figma on a calm green palette, with a reusable component library behind it.

story.title: A landing page that explains it in one look
story.body: A bold headline, two clear actions (shop or sell) and a category grid tell visitors what WaContacts is before they scroll. Green keeps it close to WhatsApp, and the orange accent marks the main calls to action.

story.title: A marketplace built for browsing
story.body: Categories sit in a persistent sidebar, filters stay above the results, and every promotion card shows its badge, price and a direct Chat button, so a buyer is one tap from the seller on WhatsApp.

story.title: Tools that help vendors sell
story.body: The vendor dashboard puts revenue, customers, conversion and order value in four colour-coded cards, with analytics, promotions and settings one tab away. A guided promotion form with live preview and tips keeps listings consistent.

story.title: Simple plans, quiet account screens
story.body: Basic, Pro and Business plans are compared side by side with the recommended tier highlighted, and sign in, profile and chat screens reuse the same components to keep the product consistent.

results: A complete product design in Figma covering 18 screens, from landing page to vendor dashboard
A reusable component library, ready for developer handoff
One consistent experience for buyers and vendors, with direct WhatsApp contact built into every listing
